founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Alex is the Technical CPO of Remade, a company enabling businesses to automate their entire visual content marketing using AI. Remade's web application transforms basic, low quality photos of any product into professional hooks.

Alex holds a BA in Computer Science from the University of Cambridge. He has contributed to earning £700k+ in revenue/ funding in past ventures.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Blendi is the co-founder of Remade, a company focused on creating professional videos using AI. He holds a BA and an MEng in Information and Computer Engineering from the University of Cambridge. At Transport for London, he developed deep learning models for CCTV event detection. His research on intra-cranial hypertension was published in the Lancet Neurology Journal.

launches.title: Remade: Automating video ad workflows using AI
launches.tagline: Create engaging TikTok hooks for your products.
launches.body:
[Launch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_zndokGv8Lk)

**Tl;DR: Remade automates visual marketing workflows. Lifestyle product brands generate TikTok hooks that land 130% higher clickthrough rate.** 

**Try it now:**

[**https://app.remade.ai/create**](https://app.remade.ai/create)

Hi everyone! We're Alex, Rehan, Chris, and Blendi — the founders of [Remade](https://www.remade.ai/).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84186&key=user_uploads/1763456/34c8021f-473b-429c-a686-1d0dbbccd54c)

We are excited to announce our product image-to-video workflow, enabling the transformation of low-quality product images into video hooks that sell.

# How it works:

1. **Upload an image of your product**

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84186&key=user_uploads/1763456/3212644d-c5d4-434d-94ae-c0009f3348dc)

2. **Use “AI Backgrounds” to create a scene for your product video.**

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84186&key=user_uploads/1763456/57fa19f5-3b50-4ad6-b8d9-b047fdae34f7)

3. **Generate your TikTok hook**

   [TikTok Hook](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dkrZIN7KDD8)

# Use Cases

**Marketing Teams**

Marketing teams use Remade to generate short-form product reels in minutes. We replace a process that corporations outsource to marketing agencies for thousands of dollars in 3-clicks. 

**Marketplaces**

Marketplaces use Remade’s Enterprise API to quickly generate product videos for their catalogs. These videos help sellers showcase products with dynamic, attention-grabbing content, which is proven to boost conversion, reduce bounce rate, and enhance the shopping experience. 

**Delivery Platforms**

Delivery platforms use Remade to generate videos for their food listings, enabling a TikTok-style User Experience.  

# **👋**Asks: How you can help

Warm intros to Heads of Image Catalogue at Delivery platforms such as Zomato, Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Glovo and Grubhub.

Warm Intros to CMO’s / Heads of Content of lifestyle product brands.

Email us at [founders@remade.ai](mailto:founders@remade.ai) for 24/7 support.

**Try it here:**

[**https://app.remade.ai/create**](https://app.remade.ai/create)

launches.title: Remade: GenAI product photography for businesses
launches.tagline: Generate studio-quality product photoshoots from your smartphone.
launches.body:
[Remade Launch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NV5d9S0cmaE)

**tl;dr:** We use AI to generate professional product images from smartphone-quality inputs. These images are then used in marketplaces, social media & ads. Get your first photoshoot for free at [app.remade.ai.](http://app.remade.ai)

Hi everyone! We're Alex, Rehan, Chris, and Blendi — the founders of [Remade](https://www.remade.ai/).

![](https://t9014441523.p.clickup-attachments.com/t9014441523/f9304638-6681-457f-ad40-a35807205621/image.png)

### **🧨 The Problem**

Traditional photography is labor-intensive, slow, and expensive. Enterprises spend thousands on photography, while smaller businesses can't afford it. Existing AI platforms struggle to capture the user's vision and maintain the consistency of input images.

### 🎉 **The Solution**

Remade replaces the entire photography pipeline with 3 steps.

1. Upload 10 photos of your item from different angles.
2. Direct the photoshoots through text prompts, or let Remade suggest prompts for you.
3. Receive studio-quality images in minutes.

![](https://t9014441523.p.clickup-attachments.com/t9014441523/1385a61e-b4fb-4535-af01-7dc92efa1706/image.png)

Remade reduces the costs of professional images by 100x and cuts delivery time from weeks to minutes. Work with us to amplify your marketing content across major social media platforms, including Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Twitter, and more.

## **Use Cases**

**Fashion**

Hiring photographers, models, studio setups, lighting experts, and stylists can be replaced with three clicks, saving you thousands of dollars.

![](https://t9014441523.p.clickup-attachments.com/t9014441523/3c3d6bae-29cc-45ae-bcda-52a88e8dd30c/image.png)

**Food**

Increase your coverage of images across multiple sales channels, including food delivery platforms and social media.

![](https://t9014441523.p.clickup-attachments.com/t9014441523/9b7fe9c1-e830-4f59-bbbb-721156c7b7ea/image.png)

**Products**

Showcase your products in scenes, build your brand, and boost advertisement engagement on social media and marketplaces.

![](https://t9014441523.p.clickup-attachments.com/t9014441523/d7f870e3-fa32-419f-934d-b157e16696c0/image.png)

**Cars**

Driving to the desert to get a cool shot of your car isn't a viable option for most car retailers. Take some pictures of your car in a parking lot, and let Remade do the rest!

![](https://t9014441523.p.clickup-attachments.com/t9014441523/426ab5fa-54f5-481f-870a-40fa47d733c5/image.png)

### **👋** **Ask: How you can help**

* If you or anyone you know is struggling with photography, [please reach out to us](https://www.remade.ai/contact-us)!
* Connect us to Delivery platforms (e.g. DoorDash, Uber Eats)
* Connect us to Enterprise leaders (Fashion Brands, Marketplaces, Car Manufacturers) that aim to reduce photography operational costs!
* Connect us to small businesses (e.g. Restaurants) that need help with Photography / Social Media management
* Give us product feedback [here](https://www.remade.ai/contact-us).

Thanks - we hope to see you on our platform! 😊🚀
